recipe_version.title: Egyptian Ful Medames with Warm Pita, Tomato, and Cucumber
recipe_version.description: Fava beans simmered and coarsely mashed with garlic, cumin, lemon, and good olive oil, topped with diced tomato, parsley, and chile, and eaten Cairo-style with warm pita, cucumber, radishes, and pickled turnips or olives.

ingredients.name: canned fava beans
ingredients.display_name: 15-oz cans fava beans (ful medames), with their liquid

ingredients.name: extra-virgin olive oil
ingredients.note: 2 tbsp in the beans, the rest to drizzle

ingredients.name: pita bread
ingredients.display_name: white pita rounds whose label lists no milk, butter, egg, or honey
ingredients.note: store-bought; required: the ingredient list shows no milk, butter, egg, honey, soy, or sesame

steps.title: Prep the garlic
steps.body: Mince the garlic and juice one lemon.

steps.title: Simmer the beans
steps.body: Tip the fava beans with their liquid into a 3-quart saucepan, add 1/2 cup water, the cumin, and 1 tsp salt, and simmer over medium, stirring, 10 minutes. Mash about half the beans with a potato masher, leaving the rest whole. Stir in the garlic, lemon juice, and 2 tbsp olive oil and simmer 2 minutes more until thick and spoonable.

steps.title: Cut the vegetables
steps.body: While the beans simmer, dice the tomatoes, chop the parsley and jalapeño, cut the cucumbers into spears, halve the radishes, and cut the second lemon into wedges (overlap stated).

steps.title: Warm the pita
steps.body: Warm the pita one at a time in a dry 10-inch skillet over medium, about 30 seconds per side, and stack in a towel.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Spoon the ful into shallow bowls, top with tomato, parsley, and jalapeño, and pour over the remaining olive oil. Serve with pita, cucumbers, radishes, olives, and lemon wedges.
